data.input_source: original demonstration states restored into original LIBERO environment; no initial-state substitution

evaluation.heldout: same tasks, distinct demonstration IDs from calibration; no unseen-task claim
evaluation.aggregation: mean seeds within case, mean cases within suite, mean four suites equally
evaluation.advance_gate: Report common softbin, action temporal KL, latent spatiotemporal KL and common composite on both complete C80 and frozen heldout80; RMSE/NMSE diagnostic, no automatic closedloop launch
evaluation.gate_scope: engineering screen on this fixed held-out cohort; not statistical superiority; next scaling stage needs independent confirmation

training.checkpoint_selection: fixed final update80 only; no held-out checkpoint selection or early stopping
training.coefficient_inputs: complete original C80 at D=1/r=1, no heldout or episode data

clipping.scope: one FP32 ratio per target Linear, shared across tokens and denoising steps
clipping.rule: scale = absmax_per_token * ratio / 7; round and clamp [-7,7]; BF16 dequantized operand
clipping.backward: input STE inside clipping range; LSQ-style scale surrogate normalized by sqrt(numel * 7); absmax treated constant
clipping.fixed: Smooth0.5/H128 signs/scales, VQ indices, B32 uint8 exponents, bias, non-target model parameters, BF16 KV

scaling.position: after fixed Smooth0.5/H128, before dynamic per-token A4
scaling.forward: D=exp2(FP32 per-input-channel log2 scales); Q_A4(Z/D;ratio) @ BF16(original decoded Wq * D).T + bias
scaling.backward: same coupled stored-weight LSQ surrogate; retain each input channel instead of B32 aggregation; sqrt(rows*1*7) normalization and layer centering
scaling.storage: additional FP32 log2 scales; original integer B32 exponents unchanged; no rounded deployment substitution
scaling.training_evaluation: same compensated BF16 weight path; backward recomputes transient compensated matrix to avoid per-step dense copies; final eval caches same compensated weights
scaling.original_weight_content: codebooks, indices, row gains and original B32 exponents frozen; BF16 compensation rounding measured in original coordinates
scaling.initialization: original C8 rho1.5 baseline, log2D=0 ratio=1; no B32 warm start

softbin.statistics: all original C80 teacher, no heldout; action per axis, latent per channel; fixed population mean/std
softbin.aggregation: KL across value bins at each paired scalar position, then mean; no spatial or temporal histogram pooling

training.loss: first10 x6 motor MSE + rho * frozen normalization_c * clean future global NMSE excluding frame0
training.checkpoint_selection: last exact update8 only; no held-out checkpoint selection

clipping.scope: one FP32 ratio per target Linear, shared across tokens and denoising steps
clipping.rule: scale = absmax_per_token * ratio / 7; round and clamp [-7,7]; BF16 dequantized operand
clipping.backward: input STE inside clipping range; LSQ-style scale surrogate normalized by sqrt(numel * 7); absmax treated constant
clipping.fixed: Smooth0.5/H128 signs/scales, VQ indices, B32 uint8 exponents, bias, non-target model parameters, BF16 KV

evaluation.heldout: same tasks, distinct demonstration IDs from calibration; no unseen-task claim
evaluation.aggregation: mean seeds within case, mean cases within suite, mean four suites equally
evaluation.advance_gate: clip_only or joint must improve BOTH first10motor_rmse and future_latent_nmse versus baseline; joint must also improve both versus equal-budget weight_only; all 80 queries required
evaluation.gate_scope: engineering screen on this fixed held-out cohort; not statistical superiority; next scaling stage needs independent confirmation

source_clipping_protocol.claim_scope: fixed-input decoded-BF16 VQ + A4 accuracy diagnostic; no closed-loop or native INT4 speed claim

relational.temperature_rule: median positive teacher neighbor distance over complete C80, frozen before training
relational.coefficient_rule: beta=0.25*mean teacher standardized Gaussian noise0.1 softbin KL / mean same corruption relational KL; separately for action and latent
relational.note: legacy metadata only; actual new KL and coefficients are defined in anchor; no action KL or action relational training

scope: paired first-round engineering experiment on previously seen cohorts; decoded BF16 VQ/dynamic fakeA4/BF16 KV; original heldout80 and paired280; no native kernel, unseen-task or independent generalization claim
initialization: same original C8 rho1.5 baseline D=1/r=1; original MSE+NMSE final80 reused only after exact replay; anchor trains fresh80, not warm-started from final80
selection: fixed final80; no heldout, episode, temperature or beta selection; all complete original cases retained
decision: Report complete C80 and heldout80 original metrics, common baseline/composite losses, gripper command events and original paired280 success with wins/losses/ties. Complete paired280 regardless of heldout sign if implementation remains valid; no automatic ablation or sweep.

anchor.graph: same-view same-time Chebyshev distance1 plus same-view same-position adjacent future time; no self edges
anchor.temperature_rule: reuse complete-C80 teacher positive-neighbor-distance median frozen by original relational preparation
anchor.coefficient_rule: beta=0.1*(rho*normalization_c)*mean_C80_initial_latent_NMSE/mean_C80_initial_anchor_KL; freeze before any update; initial loss-value matching, not gradient matching

closedloop.evaluate_both_arms: MSE reference episodes reused; only anchor_kl new280 episodes; input manifest/state/seeds/execution semantics identical
